title: Allow Topic Mode to approve ideas without reference analysis
description: Make the shared eligibility engine treat Opportunity Map as optional for Topic Mode with no competitor references, while preserving the required reference chain for Reference Mode.
businessContext: The exact VOX Simple Flow runtime generated valid Topic-mode candidates but every approval control was disabled because Idea Lab inherited the Reference Mode Opportunity Map dependency.
acceptanceCriteria: Topic Mode with no included competitor references can approve a reviewable Idea Lab artifact without an Opportunity Map.
Downstream Originality Review becomes eligible after the Topic idea is approved without requiring Opportunity Map approval.
Reference Mode still requires the approved Opportunity Map before Idea Lab is runnable or approvable.
Focused eligibility tests, typecheck, and diff checks pass.
humanEscalationConditions: Changing effective dependencies would invalidate Reference Mode approval or stale-chain semantics.
